1. **Misspelled category labels** — "Accesories" (1 row) and "Office Suplies" (2 rows) were merged into the allowed labels "Accessories" and "Office Supplies" per the rules file. Without this, categories would have been split into 6 groups instead of 4.
2. **1 exact duplicate row** — row 4 duplicated row 3 (Order_ID 2004, Lamp) and was removed so it wouldn't skew the Furniture average.

**Caveats:** Price itself was clean (no text, no negatives, no missing). The Region column has 2 missing values and a whitespace variant, but it isn't used in this question, so it was left untouched.
